metadata.title: SDLC Supply Chain Security

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for managing and constraining software supply chain risk within the Secure-SDLC.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Software dependencies, build tools, container images, CI/CD components, IaC modules, and policy-as-code sources.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern governing ingestion, verification, and bounded trust of supply chain inputs.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines dependency inventories, provenance attestations, integrity evidence, and supplier metadata as trust-relevant SDLC data.

props.name: nist-controls
props.remarks: SDLC Supply Chain implements supply chain risk and integrity controls.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices.

metadata.remarks: SDLC Supply Chain governs third-party and external inputs to the SDLC, including source dependencies, tooling, images, and automation. Supply chain integrity and provenance do not imply trust, safety, or permission to deploy.

components.title: Dependency and Tooling Ingestion
components.description: Controls the introduction of third-party code, libraries, IaC modules, images, and tools into the SDLC.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.remarks: Malicious code or tooling inserted via dependencies or build tools.

techniques.name: Stage Capabilities
techniques.remarks: Staging compromised dependencies for later execution.

techniques.name: Dependency Verification
techniques.remarks: Validating integrity and origin of dependencies.

components.title: Supply Chain Provenance
components.description: Captures and preserves origin, supplier, and build provenance for all SDLC inputs.

techniques.name: Subvert Trust Controls
techniques.remarks: Forging or obscuring provenance to make malicious inputs appear legitimate.

techniques.name: Provenance Capture
techniques.remarks: Recording and validating origin and chain-of-custody of SDLC inputs.

components.title: Supply Chain Integrity Verification
components.description: Verifies integrity of supply chain artifacts prior to use in builds or pipelines.

components.title: Supply Chain Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Defines what supply chain integrity and provenance do not grant or imply.
components.remarks: Verified provenance or integrity of a dependency does not imply safety, correctness, approval, or permission to deploy or execute.
